model: ComPact NSX MicroLogic trip unit, standard dataset (IFM / IFE interface)
applies_to: Standard dataset registers 32000-32341 served by the IFM (Modbus RTU) or IFE (Modbus TCP) interface for ComPact NSX; the same table lists availability for ComPact NS / MasterPact NT/NW and MasterPact MTZ. Per DOCA0091EN-09 (07/2022).
summary: MicroLogic trip units in ComPact NSX breakers are read over Modbus through an IFM serial interface or an IFE Ethernet interface. Schneider publishes a 'standard dataset' at registers 32000-32341 that gathers breaker status, trip causes, currents, voltages, power, energy, demand and power factor in one block. Floats and 64-bit energies are big-endian; values are already in engineering units.

addressing.note: The guide lists a hex address and a decimal register for every row, with register = address + 1 (register 32028 = 0x7D1B). Its readout example requests 0x7D1B for register 32028.

source.title: ComPact NSX - Modbus Communication User Guide
source.pages: IFM settings pp. 23-30; IFE address p. 37; table format and data types pp. 69-73; standard dataset pp. 78-97 (readout examples pp. 82-83)

notes: The guide states INT32/INT64 values are big-endian (most significant register first) and decodes total active energy 32096-32099 that way. Its FLOAT32 readout example (registers 32028-32029 returning 0x440A 0xC000 = 555 A) shows floats are high word first too.
Each description says which trip units fill the register: NSX A/E (ComPact NSX MicroLogic types A and E), NT/NW/NS A/E/P/H, and MTZ (the X column).
Bit registers come in pairs: the even register holds a validity bit for each bit of the odd register that follows.
Left out: IO module status words 32003/32005, pre-alarm and user-alarm words 32017-32023, and 32186 (maximum earth-leakage current), whose unit is printed as V.

IFE: the server address is 255 (fixed). IFM: the address comes from the two rotary switches; baud and parity are auto-detected by default. With Auto-Speed off, 4800-38400 baud and even/odd/none parity can be set in EcoStruxure Power Commission. The guide gives no fixed default and no TCP port.
One read is limited to 125 registers; the guide reads the dataset in three requests (32000-32123, 32124-32241, 32340-32435). Do not split a 64-bit energy across two reads.

integration.summary: Read the dataset with function 03 in three requests, as the guide does: 32000-32123, 32124-32241 and 32340 onward. Breaker status is at 32001, currents from 32028, voltages from 32056, power from 32072, energy from 32096, power factor at 32206-32213.
integration.enable: Fit an IFM (RS-485 Modbus) or IFE (Ethernet) interface and connect it to the trip unit over the ULP cord. No enable step is needed to read the dataset; remote control needs the locking pad open and the command interface.
quirks: IFE always answers on unit ID 255.
In Auto-Speed mode the IFM uses one stop bit with even/odd parity and two stop bits with no parity.
Voltage, power and energy registers need an E (or P/H) trip unit; type A units only fill currents.
setup: IFM: set the Modbus address on the two rotary switches; leave Auto-Speed on and send at least 25 frames so it can lock onto baud and parity.
IFE: set its IP address; the Modbus unit ID is fixed at 255.
gotchas: Changing baud or parity after auto-detection needs an IFM power cycle.
Check the validity register before trusting a status bit.
